transaction() accepts an empty ID and returns the collection endpoint typed as a single record
accountId accepts any string without StrKey validation
Effect query builders accept unvalidated account, ledger, transaction and operation identifiers

Amount conversion returns exponent notation for one stroop
Custom-header interceptor merges each request's headers into shared state, leaking headers across requests and Server instances

Post-send failure leaves no reconciliation state; retry can pay twice

Federation address domain is interpolated into an HTTPS URL without validation
Horizon pagination and link URLs are fetched with any host or scheme the response supplies
